Let \(O=(X,Y)\). The perpendicular bisector of \(AB\) is \(X=1\).  
The perpendicular bisector of \(AC\) through \((x/2,y/2)\) with slope \(-x/y\) is

\[
Y-\frac y2=-\frac xy\left(X-\frac x2\right).
\]

Substitute \(X=1\):

\[
Y=\frac y2-\frac xy\left(1-\frac x2\right)
=\frac{y^2-x(2-x)}{2y}.
\]

Using \(x^2+y^2=36\):

\[
Y=\frac{x^2+y^2-2x}{2y}
=\frac{36-2x}{2y}
=\frac{18-x}{y}.
\]

So

\[
O=\left(1,\frac{18-x}{y}\right).
\]

Then

\[
\overrightarrow{AO}=\left(1,\frac{18-x}{y}\right),\qquad
\overrightarrow{BC}=(x-2,y).
\]

Thus

\[
\overrightarrow{AO}\cdot\overrightarrow{BC}
=1(x-2)+\frac{18-x}{y}\cdot y
=x-2+18-x=16.
\]

\[
\boxed{16}
\]
